deskripsi: Latihan verbal dan bacaan bahasa Inggris: synonym, antonym, verbal analogy, word classification, logical reasoning, different word, vocabulary/idiom, iklan, dialog, recount text, dan kartu ucapan.

soal.soal: Compliant : ...
soal.penjelasan: Compliant (patuh) bersinonim dengan obedient.

soal.soal: Timid : ....
soal.penjelasan: Timid (pemalu, penakut) bersinonim dengan shy.

soal.soal: Tightfisted : ....
soal.penjelasan: Tightfisted (pelit) bersinonim dengan stingy.

soal.soal: Tedious : ....
soal.penjelasan: Tedious (membosankan) bersinonim dengan monotonous.

soal.soal: Trustworthy : ....
soal.penjelasan: Trustworthy (dapat dipercaya) bersinonim dengan dependable.

soal.soal: Commend >< ........
soal.penjelasan: Lawan kata commend (memuji) adalah blame (menyalahkan).

soal.soal: Hinder >< .....
soal.penjelasan: Lawan kata hinder (menghalangi) adalah assist (membantu).

soal.soal: Perish >< .....
soal.penjelasan: Lawan kata perish (binasa) adalah survive (bertahan hidup). Outlive juga bermakna dekat dengan survive, tetapi survive paling tepat sebagai lawan kata. Soal ini dapat ditafsirkan lain.

soal.soal: Compulsion >< ....
soal.penjelasan: Compulsion (paksaan) berlawanan dengan option (pilihan bebas).
Vow (sumpah, janji) paling berlawanan dengan denial (penyangkalan). Soal ini dapat ditafsirkan lain.

soal.soal: Doctor : Hospital = Teacher : ...
soal.penjelasan: Dokter bekerja di rumah sakit; guru bekerja di kelas (profesi : tempat kerja). Soal ini dapat ditafsirkan lain (study center).

soal.soal: Knife : Cut = Pen : ....
soal.penjelasan: Pisau digunakan untuk memotong; pena digunakan untuk menulis (alat : fungsi).

soal.soal: Bird : Nest = Bee : ...
soal.penjelasan: Burung tinggal di sarang (nest); lebah tinggal di sarang lebah (hive).

soal.soal: Big : Huge = Fast : ...
soal.penjelasan: Big dan huge bersinonim; fast dan quick bersinonim.

soal.soal: Fire : Hot = Ice : ...
soal.penjelasan: Api bersifat panas (hot); es bersifat dingin (cold).

soal.soal: Which one is not an adjective below?
soal.penjelasan: Happy, tired, dan kind adalah kata sifat; slowly adalah kata keterangan (adverb).

soal.soal: One of these words is noun; what is it?
soal.penjelasan: Beauty adalah kata benda; beautiful (adjective), beautify (verb), beautifully (adverb).

soal.soal: Choose the word that function as verb below!
soal.penjelasan: Participate adalah kata kerja; communication dan anticipation kata benda, complicated kata sifat.

soal.soal:
Roni ran fast.
The underlined word "fast" is ...
soal.penjelasan: Fast pada kalimat ini menerangkan kata kerja 'ran', jadi adverb.

soal.soal: The following are nouns, except ...
soal.penjelasan: Ability dan announcement kata benda; envious adalah kata sifat. Dietary juga umumnya kata sifat, tetapi envious jelas bukan kata benda. Soal ini dapat ditafsirkan lain (B).

soal.soal: All birds have wings. An eagle is a bird. Therefore, the eagle...
soal.penjelasan: Elang adalah burung dan semua burung punya sayap.

soal.soal: All cats like to sleep. Some pets are cats. So...
soal.penjelasan: Sebagian hewan peliharaan adalah kucing, dan semua kucing suka tidur, jadi sebagian hewan peliharaan suka tidur.

soal.soal: Leaves fall in autumn. Snow falls in winter. That means flowers bloom in...
soal.penjelasan: Musim gugur dan musim dingin sudah disebut, bunga mekar pada musim semi (spring).

soal.soal: Rice is processed in the factory. A farmer works in a field to...
soal.penjelasan: Petani bekerja di ladang untuk menanam dan memanen tanaman.

soal.soal: A tailor uses a needle and thread to make clothes. A carpenter uses tools to...
soal.penjelasan: Penjahit membuat pakaian; tukang kayu membuat furnitur.

soal.soal: Which word is different from the rest?
soal.penjelasan: Justice, honesty, dan kindness adalah sifat/nilai abstrak; bicycle adalah benda.

soal.soal: Choose the word that is different
soal.penjelasan: Mercury, Earth, dan Jupiter adalah planet; Moon adalah satelit.

soal.soal: Find the odd one out
soal.penjelasan: Square, triangle, dan rectangle adalah bangun datar; cube adalah bangun ruang.

soal.soal: Which word is the odd one out?
soal.penjelasan: Violin, guitar, dan piano adalah alat musik; painting adalah karya seni lukis.

soal.soal: Which of the following is NOT like the others?
soal.penjelasan: Asia, Europe, dan Africa adalah benua; Russia adalah negara.

soal.soal:
"When it comes to drawing, Rani is a cut above the rest."
What does the idiom "a cut above the rest" mean?

pilihan.A: She likes to draw with scissors

soal.penjelasan: 'A cut above the rest' berarti lebih baik daripada yang lain.

soal.soal:
"Tom tried to lie to his teacher, but he was caught red-handed."
What does "caught red-handed" mean?

pilihan.C: He was caught while doing something wrong

soal.penjelasan: 'Caught red-handed' berarti tertangkap basah saat melakukan kesalahan.

soal.soal:
"Even though she failed once, she decided to go the extra mile to improve."
What does "go the extra mile" mean?
soal.penjelasan: 'Go the extra mile' berarti berusaha lebih keras.

soal.soal:
"The magician's tricks were so baffling that no one could guess how he did them."
What does "baffling" most likely mean?
soal.penjelasan: Baffling (membingungkan) bermakna confusing.

soal.soal:
"The children were completely exhausted and fell asleep quickly."
What does "exhausted" mean?
soal.penjelasan: Exhausted (kelelahan) bermakna tired.

My School Field Trip

Last Friday, our class went on a field trip to the city museum. It was our first time visiting the museum together. We were very excited because our teacher told us to be careful and pay attention during the trip. When we arrived, a guide showed us around the museum. We saw many interesting things like old paintings, fossils, and ancient tools. The guide explained the history behind each exhibit, and we asked many questions. After the tour, we had lunch in the museum garden. We shared our food and talked about our favorite exhibits. I liked the dinosaur fossils the most because they looked very big and scary! Before going back to school, we took a group photo in front of the museum. It was a fun and educational day. I hope we can go on another field trip soon.

What is the text about?

pilihan.A: A trip to the zoo with family
pilihan.C: A field trip to the city museum
pilihan.D: A day at school studying history

soal.penjelasan: Teks menceritakan kunjungan lapangan kelas ke museum kota.
